structural_change: The compactr3 failed the authoritative0.096um/0.60 pin-capacity audit before adoption. r4 returns to original388.8um face, and partitions each face clock into two actual half-face roots. Input control fields split at4SMs to preserve unique source-clock ownership. Body/core and one raw calendar clock are separate. Literal windows reserve all six clock entries; every data window cut<=0.60. Zero ordinary data/calendar stages added. Physical/native/typed grant still pending. f4hc (Claude H-SM 1815): host pin-flop row moved to a 7th clock entry clk_hcfg (own short CTS root like the W/E face roots, R~122/spread~12 there); zero edges added (ot_static_cmd_target_core_pc = core with clk_pin on the pin-flop block only). Die delta: one more writer clock entry pin (N face M5 x 70.62). r5 (Claude H-SM 1817): square 265.68 x 265.68 outline, faces W host+rdata_lo / S rdata_hi / E wq_lo / N wq_hi, <= 6 pins/um, recipe 4 (no pin hold pads, hold_budget die), clk_hcfg host entry kept.

reroute_reason.fix: c8e94d78d native capture 213.2 (late core-root leaf -> 6 hold BUFx2 per host input); f4e5 (hold ECO goal 5) NEEDS_RTL TT -37.85/FF -27.04; f4hc (clk_hcfg entry) NEEDS_RTL TT -46.54/FF -9.57 in the 2.7:1 pin-limited outline. r5 = square 265.68 x 265.68, each half-bus on its own full face (<= 6 pins/um), recipe 4.
